description: This source file provides a helper function for resolving URLs, specifically overriding certain auth endpoint URLs to point to an external domain. It includes logic to match specific API paths and conditionally replace the base URL with an external URL for those endpoints.

methods.name: resolveAuthEndpointUrl(path, baseUrl)
methods.description: Resolves a full URL for authentication-related endpoints, forcing certain paths to use an external domain and others to use the provided base URL.
